description: This Java class 'ProductStoreSurveyWrapper' extends 'SurveyWrapper' and manages survey rendering for product store applications within the OFBiz framework. It handles survey templates, result templates, and response logic.

classes.name: ProductStoreSurveyWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for handling product store surveys, extending SurveyWrapper, with methods for rendering survey and result templates, and managing survey application data.

methods.name: ProductStoreSurveyWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the survey wrapper with survey application data, party ID, pass-through parameters, and default values.

methods.name: callResult
methods.description: Sets the callResult flag indicating whether the survey response has been processed.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the survey or result template based on response status and availability of templates.
